definitions: The process of converting text to a common case (e.g., all lowercase or all uppercase) for comparison or processing, often used in computer science and linguistics.
A method of normalizing strings by mapping them to a common case, typically for case-insensitive matching.
examples: The search algorithm uses case-folding to ensure accurate results.
Case-folding is crucial for many natural language processing tasks.
Consider the implications of case-folding on different character sets.
